name: Boon Lay
summary: West EWL town with Jurong Industrial Estate gravity, mall errands at Boon Lay / Jurong Point adjacency, and HDB value for west-office households.
body: Boon Lay is the west heartland shortlist when your office pulls toward Jurong Island logistics, one-north via EWL hops, or west industrial campuses — and you want whole-flat value without paying the Jurong East interchange premium. Boon Lay MRT plus Jurong Point / surrounding plazas cover daily errands; Chinese Garden / lakeside edges are a short hop when you want green. Housing is HDB-dominant with suburban condo pockets. Expect heartland texture: void-deck life, feeder-bus dependency for deep estate blocks, and industrial-edge traffic on some arterials. Walk the block at 8am on a weekday before you LOI. Compare with Jurong East when you want mall-hub density and NSL/EWL interchange access, Jurong West for Pioneer-side sprawl, and Clementi when NUS / one-north adjacency matters more than deep-west rents.
bestFor: families wanting space over mall prestige
car-light renters near Boon Lay MRT
watchOuts: Longer CBD rides than Jurong East interchange living
Secondhand smoke / void-deck event density in older blocks
housingMix: HDB-dominant town with suburban condo pockets; limited landed.
commuteNotes: East-West Line at Boon Lay; model door-to-desk via Jurong East if your office is central. Feeder timing matters for deep estate blocks.
